beforeImage.name: Avolta Renewable Holdings, LLC
beforeImage.subsector: Renewable natural gas from dairy waste
beforeImage.description: Avolta Renewable Holdings is a renewable natural gas platform focused on dairy projects that capture biogas from manure and upgrade it to pipeline-quality fuel. Its end markets include gas utilities, transportation fuel markets, and environmental credit programs, with cash flows supported by offtake and regulatory value streams tied to low-carbon fuel production. The platform follows an asset-heavy development and ownership model built around digester infrastructure, gas upgrading facilities, and pipeline interconnections. Energy Capital Partners said in February 2022 that it had committed capital to a newly formed joint venture with Avolta to develop a series of U.S. dairy RNG projects. Public materials since then continue to describe the company as a growing dairy RNG developer with a project pipeline across major livestock regions.

afterImage.name: Avolta Renewable Holdings
afterImage.subsector: Renewable natural gas from dairy waste
afterImage.description: Avolta Renewable Holdings, LLC is a U.S. renewable-natural-gas platform formed as a joint venture between Energy Capital Partners and Avolta, LLC in February 2022. Operating through the Avolta Development brand, the company develops, finances, owns and operates dairy and landfill RNG projects, including feedstock and site rights, digesters, gas-upgrading equipment, pipeline interconnections, offtake and environmental-credit arrangements. End markets include pipeline gas utilities, transportation-fuel programs and other low-carbon fuel buyers. ECP continues to list the platform as current, and Avolta published current Texas operating activity in May 2026. Exact ownership percentages, governance economics, ECP fund and legal holding vehicle are not publicly disclosed. Avolta, LLC is headquartered in Charleston, West Virginia; Texas, Florida and Arizona are operating or project locations rather than headquarters. No direct sale or signed pending platform exit was identified through August 19, 2026. Avolta Energy, Nacelle and individual project SPVs are not part of this canonical company record.
